evals.prompt: 我和朋友去京都三天，住在京都站附近。我们喜欢走路和拍照，寺庙挑经典的，不想逛商场；每天两餐，午餐便宜、晚餐吃当地特色但每人每天不超过 600 元。请给每天按时间排的路线，换公交就另起一行，顺路但值得的景点可以保留。
evals.expected_output: A date-appropriate three-day itinerary anchored at Kyoto Station, with walk-only arrows, separate transit rows, photo durations, meal choices that fit the budget, and no unrequested mall shopping. Volatile hours/fares and booking needs are sourced or labeled for verification.

assertions.name: Three date-separated days
assertions.description: The output clearly covers all three days.

assertions.name: Transit split from walking chains
assertions.description: Arrows connect only walking segments; bus/subway transfers are separate rows with route/direction or explicit research caveat.

assertions.name: Lodging anchor and budget
assertions.description: The plan starts/ends routes relative to Kyoto Station and provides two meals/day with an explicit daily total under CNY 600 or clearly flags estimates.

assertions.name: No shopping filler
assertions.description: No mall/retail itinerary is added; worthwhile photo walks are retained.

evals.prompt: 帮我规划新加坡两天。我周五晚上到，周日 16:00 的航班，住在 Bugis，喜欢自然景观但也想看经典城市建筑。我不托运行李、会去柜台 check-in，预算中等。请把住宿、机场交通、门票、吃饭和费用都考虑进去。
evals.expected_output: A two-day plan that includes lodging and bag logistics, protects the Sunday flight, reasons about airport arrival from the route/check-in cutoff rather than using a generic buffer, balances nature with iconic architecture, and separates confirmed facts from current estimates and booking advice.

assertions.name: Lodging and baggage are routed
assertions.description: Bugis lodging, arrival night, and Sunday bag/check-out handling are explicitly included.

assertions.name: Airport deadline is reasoned about
assertions.description: Separates leave-lodging, airport arrival, check-in cutoff, and gate target; does not prescribe a generic arrival buffer without explaining airline-specific uncertainty.

assertions.name: Nature and urban landmarks both included
assertions.description: Both requested categories appear in the itinerary and are connected plausibly.

assertions.name: Budget and booking status are transparent
assertions.description: Major transit, admission, and meal costs are included or marked as estimates; advance-booking items have a channel/status or are flagged for verification.

evals.prompt: 请帮我审一下这份巴黎三日行程是不是顺路，景点不要因为稍微绕路就删，尤其喜欢河边散步和拍照；纯购物可以删。标出不可能的时间、需要提前买票的项目和每天交通大概花费。
evals.expected_output: A route review that preserves worthwhile riverside/photo detours, removes only low-value shopping, identifies concrete timing/backtracking/closure risks, and gives actionable booking and transport-cost advice without claiming unverified schedules are confirmed.

assertions.name: Requests missing itinerary
assertions.description: Recognizes no Paris schedule was attached and asks for the actual itinerary or file instead of inventing route findings.

assertions.name: Preserves valuable detours
assertions.description: Affirms that scenic riverside/photo detours should be evaluated for value rather than removed only for distance.

assertions.name: Explains review scope
assertions.description: States concrete checks it will make for timing, backtracking, booking needs, and transport costs once the itinerary is supplied.
